name: HKU MR-safe robot
full_name: HKU MR-safe hydraulic robotic manipulator for MRI-guided intracardiac (EP) catheterization
group: The University of Hong Kong, Department of Mechanical Engineering (Ka-Wai Kwok; Kit-Hang Lee, Ziyang Dong, Xiaomei Wang) with Imperial College London (Su-Lin Lee, Wayne Luk) and CUHK Prince of Wales Hospital (Alex P. W. Lee)
versions: 2018 MR-safe hydraulic manipulator (lee2018_mr, full); 2018 model-based (constant-curvature) vs model-free (Jacobian estimated online from EM tip data, no training) teleoperation with a Novint Falcon leader, 10 participants (wang2018_experimental, full); 2019 high-performance continuous hydraulic motor (dong2019_highperformance, title); 2022 upgraded 3-DoF platform with three-cylinder hydraulic actuation units, multicore FBG shape sensing, MR tracking markers and a learning-based piecewise-constant-curvature model; 800 x 140 x 210 mm, insertion 0-340 mm (dong2022_shape, full)
target_anatomy: cardiac electrophysiology: left atrium, pulmonary vein isolation
devices_driven: standard clinical EP ablation catheter (about 1.5 m, diameter < 3 mm) 2022: Thermocool Bi-Directional EP catheter (Biosense Webster), 8 Fr, about 2.67 mm (dong2022 Sec. II-A, IV-A).
n_dof_detail: 4 in lee2018 (steering/bending, rotation, coarse insertion, fine insertion; lee2018 Table I); 3 (bending, rotation, insertion) in wang2018 Fig. 1 and dong2022 Fig. 6 caption
translation_detail: other: master-slave hydraulic rolling-diaphragm actuators; coarse insertion through a transmission belt, fine insertion stage 2022: rolling-diaphragm three-cylinder actuation units for rotation and insertion (dong2022 Sec. IV-A, Table I).
rotation_detail: hydraulic rolling-diaphragm piston pair to gear (rotary) unit
device_range: clinically used EP catheters held in modular 3D-printed holders (lee2018); 2022 ranges: bending -60 to 60 deg at the catheter tip, rotation -360 to 360 deg, insertion 0-340 mm (dong2022 Table I)
footprint_mm: 780 x 105 x 210 (lee2018); 800 x 140 x 210 (2022 platform, dong2022 Table I)
force_sensing: none on the catheter; hydraulic force-transmission efficiency estimated 70%
haptics_leader: Novint Falcon 3D haptic device with a Unity virtual endoscopic view (wang2018 Sec. "Robot control interface"); 2022: hydraulic master units driven by motors in the control room, no haptic leader described (dong2022 Sec. IV-A)
imaging_compat: MR safe: 1.5 T GE SIGNA, SNR loss < 2%, no artefacts; active MR tracking coils on the catheter 2022: tested in a 1.5 T GE SIGNA; 10 m nylon pipelines at 0.1 MPa (dong2022 Sec. V-G, Table I); MR tracking markers about 0.48 mm (Sec. II-C); the tip electrode causes an image artefact (Sec. V-G).
validation_detail: LA phantom ablation task, 127 targets (lee2018_mr Fig. 8); 10 subjects, model-based vs model-free in random order, 121 target spheres around the pulmonary vein ostium in a soft printed LA phantom (wang2018 Sec. "Simulated ablation task"); 2022: pulmonary vein isolation on a slice of swine tissue in a silicone LA phantom with pulsatile flow, 12 of 15 targets reached (80.0 %) (dong2022 Sec. V-B to V-F); in the 1.5 T scanner, marker tracking and feedback control with the LA phantom in a water container, no ablation reported in the scanner (dong2022 Sec. V-G)
key_numbers: ranges: steering +/-45 deg (0.063 deg), rotation +/-360 deg (0.504 deg), coarse 0-200 mm (0.115 mm), fine 0-30 mm (0.016 mm); about 10 m nylon pipelines 6/4 mm, distilled water <= 0.3 MPa; hysteresis 0.88-1.29 mm for 0.05-0.2 MPa preload; delay 45-66 ms at 15 Hz (lee2018_mr Table I, Sec. III); model-free vs model-based (10 subjects): tip-to-target distance 5.61 vs 6.94 mm (19.1 %, p = 0.08), missed targets 33.3 vs 51.9 % (35.8 %, p = 0.03), maximum continuously missed targets 46.2 % fewer (p = 0.01) (wang2018 Table 1); 2022: shape error 2.33 deg per FBG segment; position error 0.63 mm over 21 segments and 1.53 mm at the tip (max 2.27 mm); path following 0.62 mm mean (2.34 mm max) with the learning-based model vs 1.07 mm (4.27 mm) analytical; autonomous targeting 16.9 s per target (dong2022 Sec. V-A, V-B, V-D, V-E)
sim2real_detail: none found (wang2018: the model-free controller updates its Jacobian online from EM data; dong2022: the network is trained on FBG data of the real catheter, Sec. III-B)
